plan.title: SHG Loan Register Overview
plan.subtitle: Repayment status and loan purposes of SHG loans

panels.title: Total loans
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Repayment status distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status", COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Loans by purpose
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", COUNT(*) AS loan_count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY loan_count DESC

panels.title: Overdue loans by block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS overdue_loans FROM shg_loan_register WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY overdue_loans DESC

plan.narrative: The dashboard provides a concise overview of the SHG loan register. The first KPI panel shows the total number of loans recorded, represented by {{p1}}. The pie chart visualizes the distribution of loan repayment statuses, highlighting the proportion of loans that are Regular, Overdue, and Closed, with each slice corresponding to {{p2.0.loan_count}}, {{p2.1.loan_count}}, and {{p2.2.loan_count}} respectively. The bar chart breaks down loans by their primary purpose, displaying the count for each purpose category; the purpose with the highest count is {{p3.0.Purpose}} with {{p3.0.loan_count}} loans. Finally, the table lists the number of overdue loans per block, with the block having the most overdue loans being {{p4.0.Block}} and a total of {{p4.0.overdue_loans}} loans.
